item.title: Mailday 0.1.10 · build 11
item.description:
# Mailday 0.1.10 — quieter text fields
- Removed blue focus boxes from text fields throughout the app: Signatures, account details, search, composer, calendar forms, scheduling and Smart Inbox rules. - Text fields use a subtle neutral underline while editing. The signature editor stays borderless, and native account/password fields no longer show the system blue focus ring. - Keyboard focus remains visible on buttons, switches and other controls. Existing Settings functionality and Not ready indicators are unchanged.
This development preview supports Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Save open drafts, then use Mailday → Check for Updates and Restart & update.
